estimator: median of profiled minus unprofiled leader-wall differences
bootstrap: 10000 resamples of six matched fresh-process pairs; seed 384
order: Pair 1 profiled then unprofiled is excluded as warmup; pairs 2-7 alternate unprofiled-first / profiled-first
conclusion: The observed paired interval includes zero. A positive collection cost is not resolved within this campaign's variability; negative apparent deltas are not an optimization claim.
limitations: One source/binary/workload/CPU and 1 ms period; not a general overhead bound.
Shared-host lock was released between every run. Inter-run thermal/turbo/cache history is not controlled.
Wall brackets include launch/loader/exit observation. Resource CPU time has microsecond source resolution.
